label: Hero Section
title: Template Hub
subtitle: Merge Word, Excel and PowerPoint templates with SharePoint list data in five guided steps. Your documents, generated where your data already lives.
className: min-h-[50vh] md:min-h-[70vh] bg-(--st-color-surface) text-(color:--st-color-text-strong) mt-20 rounded-b-lg

label: Key Features
title: Everything you need to generate documents at scale
subtitle: From template to saved file, without leaving Microsoft 365

items.title: Five-step wizard
items.description: Pick a template, choose list data, choose where to save, adjust file names, generate.

items.title: Word, Excel and PowerPoint
items.description: One placeholder syntax across every Office format, built on the Open XML SDK.

items.title: SharePoint list data
items.description: Merge one or many list items into documents, with filename patterns and duplicate handling.

items.title: AI document analysis
items.description: Analyse generated documents with Azure OpenAI and review the findings next to the files.

items.title: Template management
items.description: Create blank templates, validate placeholders and convert existing documents into templates.

items.title: Built for Microsoft 365
items.description: Entra ID sign-in, admin consent, per-tenant licensing and role-based admin tools.

label: Deployment Options
title: Run it your way: SaaS or self-hosted
subtitle: Start in minutes on our hosted service, or run Template Hub on your own infrastructure when policy requires it. The product and licensing are the same either way.

items.title: SaaS
items.description: We host and update Template Hub. Sign in with your Microsoft 365 account and start generating documents.

items.title: Self-hosted
items.description: Deploy Template Hub in your own environment and keep it under your own operations and security controls.

imageAlt: Template Hub as SaaS or self-hosted
